scope.purpose: Rights-reviewed empirical evaluation of the declared Choro research hypotheses; model training is not implied.
scope.retention_policy: Specify before any source retrieval; do not retain source files beyond the approved scope.

limitations: An empty source list is intentionally blocked and authorizes no acquisition, transcription, analysis, training, publication, or redistribution.
Catalogue labels are leads, not legal determinations; review each exact artifact for the requested use and jurisdiction.
The gate checks recorded evidence and scope consistency. It does not provide legal advice or independently determine copyright status.

source_entry_contract.selection_rule: Name exact work or movement identifiers within each artifact; collections must not be treated as a single undifferentiated work. State the predeclared selection basis.
source_entry_contract.review_scope_digest: rights_review.reviewed_scope_sha256 is SHA-256 over canonical JSON computed by scripts/muse_choro_input_manifest.py::review_scope_sha256. It binds the source record, exact source artifact, selected work/movement IDs, selection basis, four rights layers, declared use/commercial/jurisdiction/output/retention scope, and the exact frozen analysis-plan ID/path/SHA-256/registration date/registration URL. Any change invalidates the review-scope digest.
source_entry_contract.analysis_plan_contract: For any non-empty source list, scope.analysis_plan must identify an exact repository-relative JSON plan whose on-disk SHA-256 matches the manifest. The plan file must use schema muse-choro-preregistered-analysis-plan-v1 and top-level status registered; set pre_registration.status=registered and hypotheses_frozen/null_models_frozen/thresholds_frozen=true; and provide an ISO registered_on date plus HTTPS registration_record_url identical to manifest values. Its design must include source_version_pin, study_question and authorized_source_bindings that exactly match all source IDs, record/file URLs, relative artifact paths, artifact SHA-256 values, byte counts and selected work/movement IDs in the approved input manifest; non-empty inclusion_criteria, exclusion_criteria, primary_outcomes and sensitivity_analyses; at least one hypothesis with unique id, statement, primary_test, unit_of_analysis and falsification_rule; at least one null model with unique id, description, preserved_properties, randomization_or_permutation and unit_of_resampling; explicit effect_size_rule, uncertainty_rule and decision_rule; and multiplicity_correction, missing_data_policy, split_strategy and deviation_policy. Boolean freeze flags alone are insufficient. Rights-review scope digests bind this exact plan identity/content digest; rights review and independent approval must not predate plan registration. This checker validates bytes and recorded fields, not scientific adequacy or the truth of an external registration. The checked-in analysis-plan template is intentionally not registered and cannot authorize analysis.
